subject: storytime
title: Beekle words
about: An imaginary friend is born on a faraway island and waits to be picked by a child, then sails to the real world on his own and finds a girl who gives him his name. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the story, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, with him reading the words he practised.

book.author: Dan Santat
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A Caldecott Medal picture book about an imaginary friend who goes looking for his child.

passage.text:
Beekle Alice island friend
wait pick kid real
city boat sail star
park tree crown name
hug swing

cards.note: capital B, it is his name; ee says long e; le says ul: Bee-kul
capital A, it is her name; ce says s and the i stays short: Al-iss
the i says its name and the s is silent: eye-land
ea says long e; real means not pretend
c says s before i; y at the end says ee: sit-ee
t-r blend; ee says long e
c-r blend; ow says ou as in out, like in cow
magic e makes a say its name
s-w blend; ng is one sound
